question: what are the state of the art methods?
title: Compound Probabilistic Context-Free Grammars for Grammar Induction
answer_rationale: Text 10 states that "the neural PCFG/compound PCFG are strong models for grammar induction" and "the compound PCFG outperforms other models by an appreciable margin on both English and Chinese," indicating these are state-of-the-art methods. Text 4 also references "recent state-of-the-art methods" and compares against them, supporting the conclusion that neural PCFG and compound PCFG are current leading approaches.
